info.name: Student ID - Server Rules Service
info.description: UNRELEASED owned business HTTP candidate; not a live full-stack acceptance claim. Current reads require actual Session membership and Gateway target-credential/verified-player support. The old caller-facts evaluation is retired with 410 CALLER_FACTS_RETIRED; the service-only ID evaluation is invoked by Moderation using its own service identity, never public player tokens or service credentials in this collection. Credential generation/provenance and Rules authoritative HTTP consumers are implemented locally, but peer schema review, exact Gateway bindings and live integration remain pending. Published lab3 images predate these changes. Refreshed 2026-11-12 from shared dev bdf7190. Gateway boundary and separate operational log checks are included. Current private service source was not accessible during this review; public shared contracts do not establish runtime acceptance. See ../docs/lab4-configuration-review.md.

exec: pm.test('No server-side failure or false green', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));
pm.test('Response has a UUID trace', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i));

item.name: Lab 4 Task 3 - Gateway boundary
item.description: Public Gateway health, JWT and internal-route boundary checks. Run with the current Lab 4 subscriber-queue Gateway/Broker deployment.

request.description: Public Gateway relay for this service's existing health/readiness endpoint. Requires a running, healthy service and its database; this does not probe the custom broker.

exec: pm.test('Service health through Gateway: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

request.description: Explicit No Auth overrides the collection bearer token. Gateway must reject this request before forwarding it to the owned service.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });

request.description: No Auth disables inherited authorization; the deliberately incomplete Bearer header contains no token. Gateway must return its existing 401 error.

exec: pm.test('Gateway rejects unauthorized access: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Gateway uses the existing authentication error contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('gateway-service'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });

pm.test('Authentication error matches the response trace ID', () => { const traceId = pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id'); pm.expect(traceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.traceId).to.eql(traceId); });
pm.test('Internal route is not public', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.collectionVariables.unset('ruleId');
pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleCode', 'LAB3_' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}').replace(/-/g, '').toUpperCase());

pm.test('Rule created with an ID', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const id = pm.response.json().ruleId; pm.expect(id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleId', id); });

exec: pm.test('Current snapshot contains created rule and a version', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.rulesetVersion).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.rules.some(r => r.code === pm.collectionVariables.get('ruleCode'))).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Unverified caller facts are refused', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(410); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('CALLER_FACTS_RETIRED'); });
pm.test('Rule deleted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Deletion persisted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('RULE_NOT_FOUND'); });
pm.test('Invalid ID is rejected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INVALID_RULE_ID'); });
pm.test('Invalid type is rejected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('INVALID_RULE'); });

item.name: Lab 4 Task 4 - Operational logs
item.description: Start the local log-download endpoint for the exact running Compose project. Set logDownloadUrl and a private logDownloadToken; this is a separate operations credential, not the collection's Player JWT. The download is limited to this owned service and its declared numeric replicas. To download the whole system, omit the service query on the same endpoint.

exec: pm.test('Log exporter health: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Exporter is UP', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('UP'); });

request.description: A finite text attachment from the selected Compose project. A 503 means the local Docker/configuration source is unavailable; it is not a successful empty log export.

exec: pm.test('Log download: HTTP 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Private text attachment', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.eql('text/plain; charset=utf-8'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.match(/^attachment; filename="student-id-logs-\d{8}T\d{6}Z\.log"$/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.eql('no-store'); });

pm.test('Owned service snapshot includes the requested bounds', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('services=rules-service'); pm.expect(text).to.include('since=15m; tail=200 per container'); });
pm.test('Missing operations token: HTTP 401', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

pm.test('Operations authentication error is traceable', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('UNAUTHORIZED'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate')).to.eql('Bearer'); });
pm.test('Invalid tail: HTTP 400', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

pm.test('Invalid query uses the operations contract', () => { const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('INVALID_LOG_QUERY'); pm.expect(error.service).to.eql('log-download-service'); pm.expect(error.traceId).to.eql(pm.response.headers.get('X-Trace-Id')); });
